name: Big Tex Gym
known_for: Serious lifting crowd, old-school and specialty equipment, loud floor, 24/7 key-tag access. Boxing area and infrared sauna on site.

plans.name: Month-to-Month
plans.note: Plus tax. Auto-renewal with a 2-month minimum. The $45/yr maintenance fee is charged 75 days after signup, then annually on that date.

plans.name: 1 Month Paid in Full
plans.note: $70 paid upfront. Paid-in-full plans carry no annual maintenance fee.

plans.name: 3 Months Paid in Full
plans.note: $190 paid upfront ($64/mo as published by the gym). No annual fee.

plans.name: 6 Months Paid in Full
plans.note: $350 paid upfront ($59/mo as published by the gym). No annual fee.

plans.name: 12 Months Paid in Full
plans.note: $630 paid upfront ($53/mo as published by the gym). No annual fee.

pricing_note: Also offers a $35 week pass, a $45/mo service discount (military, police, fire, first responders) and a $135 3-month student plan, both in-person signup only. Day pass excludes sauna access.
